text:
Jason Zucker is 34 and losing ice time. He played 7.7 and 9.7 minutes in back-to-back games against Philadelphia and Washington this month, and he is at 12 minutes a night over 16 games. Sabre Noise ran the headline "Buffalo Sabres have a troubling Jason Zucker situation brewing," and the numbers explain why there's a debate.

The chances are good. He has 4.15 expected goals, our measure of chance quality, and he gets them at 1.29 expected goals per 60, but he has only two goals. Our numbers flag him as due, and the bigger problem is around him: the Sabres have scored 9.9 fewer goals than expected with him on the ice. At five on five Buffalo has had just 42.2% of the expected goals with him out there, 8.82 points worse than without him, so it isn't all bad luck. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking still has him at 6.2 scoring chances per 60 from the slot, 80th percentile. Our numbers project 15 goals; whether he gets the minutes to reach them is the question.
headline: Jason Zucker's minutes are shrinking in Buffalo
